mapper.select: select concat('优惠：充值', pay_money, '元,赠送', gift_money, '元！') from member_discount_rules where deleted = 0 and store_id = #{store_id} and status = 1 and exprice_time > now() order by pay_money asc
select distinct city_name from member_store_info where deleted = 0 and status = 0 order by create_time asc

select s.store_id,s.store_name,s.city_name,s.head_img,s.lat,s.lon,s.address,s.status,s.kefu_phone
,( 6371 * ACOS( COS(RADIANS(#{lat})) * COS(RADIANS(lat)) * COS(RADIANS(lon) - RADIANS(#{lon})) + SIN(RADIANS(#{lat})) * SIN(RADIANS(lat)) ) ) AS distance
from member_store_info s
s.deleted=0 and s.status=0
and s.city_name=#{cityName}
and locate(#{name},s.store_name)>0
order by distance asc
select * from member_store_info where deleted = 0 and status = 0 and store_id = #{storeId}

select s.store_name `key`,s.store_id `value` from member_store_info s left join member_store_user su ON su.store_id=s.store_id where s.deleted = 0 and su.deleted=0 and su.user_id=#{userId}
and locate(#{cityName},s.city_name)>0
and locate(#{name},s.store_name)>0
order by s.store_id asc
select * from member_room_info where deleted = 0 and store_id = #{storeId} order by sort_id asc

select s.store_name `key`,s.store_id `value` from member_store_info s where s.deleted = 0 and s.status = 0
and locate(#{cityName},s.city_name)>0
and locate(#{name},s.store_name)>0
order by s.store_id asc
select * from member_room_info where deleted = 0 and room_id = #{roomId}

select store_id as 'key', store_name as 'value' from member_store_info where deleted = 0 and store_id in
#{item}
